title: SIDE STORY: INVITATION TO WINE RERUN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: INVITATION TO WINE RERUN
EVENT DURATION: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Invitation to Wine event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
[Tales of Three-Mountains] Duration: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Mountain Top] Duration: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 21, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[ESCORT DUTY]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete "Escort Duty" missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Kroos the Keen Glint, Shan-Ch'eng Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Canned Tea.
[XINGYU INN]
DURATION: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Canned Tea by clearing event stages and [Escort Duty]. Canned Tea can be used to redeem items from [Xingyu Inn].
MAIN REWARDS: Kroos the Keen Glint's Token, Shan-Ch'eng Teahouse Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
NOTE:

- The requirements to obtain certain medals of this event have been updated. Players who have participated in the original event and met the adjusted requirements will receive the corresponding medals once log in.
- Once the rerun ends, the Medal Set of this event can no longer be obtained via any method, including the [Side Story].
- This event rerun will carry on the stage progress and First Clear progress.

- The once-only rewards in the rerun will automatically be converted to Intelligence Certificates for players who have already claimed them. Please refer to [Intelligence Certificate Exchange Info] for more details.
- [Intelligence Certificate Area] will be restocked as the event rerun begins. In addition, new redeemable will be added.
- Operators Ling, Lee, Kroos the Keen Glint, and Blacknight will gain more trust during the event rerun.
After the event rerun ends, this event will be archived into [Side Story] and become permanently available.
02 0011 COLLECTION NEW ARRIVAL AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfit will be available at the Store:
◆ 0011 Collection – Along the Corridor for Kroos the Keen Glint
03 0011 COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
◆0011 Collection - Unfettered Freedom for Nian
◆0011 Collection - Doctor of Faces for Aak
◆0011 Collection - Just A Driver for Hung
04 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET - SHAN-CH'ENG TEAHOUSE
DURATION: August 11, 2023, 10:00 (UTC-7) – August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Invitation to Wine event rewards and redeem in Xingyu Inn (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from August 11, 2023, 10:00 to August 25, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
